name: ALP Industrial Real Estate Investment Trust
source: ALP Industrial REIT Half-Year Report 2026 (issuer, unaudited interim)
source_note: ALP Industrial REIT listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange on 11 March 2026. The figures are the unaudited condensed interim financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026, taken from the issuer inaugural Half-Year Report 2026, and are stated in US dollars, not thousands. No audited annual statement exists yet, so the only period on file is this interim.
